description.en: Reviews the recent changes and writes artifacts/review.md with findings ordered by severity.
description.es: Revisa los cambios recientes y escribe artifacts/review.md con los hallazgos ordenados por gravedad.

nodes.text: Review the recent changes in {{projectName}} (use git log and git diff to find them), focusing on {{focus}}. Do not modify any source file. Write your findings to artifacts/review.md: a short summary, then a list of findings ordered by severity, each with the file, the problem and a suggested fix.

nodes.message: Open artifacts/review.md and read the findings. Approve to finish.
